senses.definition: Understood by only a small group, because it assumes background that most people lack.
distractors: So small or so easy that it does not deserve the time it would take to discuss it.
Harder or bigger than the person asking has assumed.
Made deliberately hard to follow so that the plain version stays out of reach.
What someone can do but cannot fully explain, such as judgement, feel, or a sense of fit.
The accumulated history one organisation holds about why its own systems were built that way.
